branch_assignments.rationale: Latent world supervision directly integrated with VLA action learning.
Spatial grounding and action-trace reasoning benchmark.
Generated world futures converted into robot actions.

paper.title: MolmoSpaces: A Large-Scale Open Ecosystem for Robot Navigation and Manipulation
paper.data: 230K+ indoor environments, 130K objects, 48K manipulable objects, 42M stable grasps, and eight tasks
paper.method: simulator-agnostic asset, scene, grasp, task, rollout, and evaluation stack
paper.task: train and evaluate navigation and manipulation under controlled long-tail variation
paper.novelty: unifies large cross-simulator scenes, objects, grasps, and benchmarks
paper.project_relevance: direct executable-world data and evaluation substrate

paper.title: VLA-JEPA: Enhancing Vision-Language-Action Model with Latent World Model
paper.data: SSV2, DROID, BridgeV2, LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, SimplerEnv, and real manipulation
paper.method: leakage-free latent future prediction followed by action fine-tuning
paper.task: language-conditioned manipulation with training-time world supervision
paper.novelty: action-relevant future learning without leakage or inference overhead

paper.title: Point-It-Out: Benchmarking Embodied Reasoning for Vision Language Models in Multi-Stage Visual Grounding
paper.data: 600+ human-annotated QA pairs across four embodied scenarios
paper.method: three-stage box, point, and visual-trace evaluation

paper.title: Geometry-aware 4D Video Generation for Robot Manipulation
paper.data: multi-view RGB-D manipulation, pointmaps, poses, and real examples
paper.method: cross-view pointmap-supervised video diffusion plus 6-DoF pose tracking
paper.task: generate aligned RGB-D futures and executable trajectories
paper.novelty: combines video generation with metric cross-view geometry

paper.title: GEM-4D: Geometry-Enhanced Video World Models for Robot Manipulation
paper.data: DROID, RLBench, Bridge, RT-1, and real UF ARM tasks
paper.method: dense correspondence distillation plus adaptive inverse dynamics
paper.task: generate geometry-consistent futures and robot trajectories
paper.novelty: training-only geometry teacher with no inference overhead

paper.title: ORV: 4D Occupancy-centric Robot Video Generation
paper.data: ORV-Data, BridgeV2, DROID, RT-1, 4D occupancy, actions, and multiple views
paper.method: 7-DoF action AdaLN plus rendered 4D occupancy guidance
paper.task: controllable robot video generation and sim-to-real augmentation
paper.novelty: dense occupancy bridges sparse controls and pixel generation

registry_noops.reason: Official infrastructure release retained as discovery context; underlying papers handled individually.
